items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m not Santero by the way, I’m like sort of one-on- one.

ctx.x: Is it a healthy religion or is it shrinking in numbers?

I think it’s growing. It’s a very — I’m not Santero by the way, I’m like sort of one-on- one. It’s a very open religion. It doesn’t reject other religions. It’s always been synchronized with the Christian religions. So like I can go to a ceremony and pay my respects there and then I can walk into a Catholic church and it’s not a problem you know. So it’s very open. And it’s based mostly on self-improvement. Like how can you be a better person. And that’s what they profess, as well as other religions. But this one…
All three of you gentlemen seem at ease with others and fairly peaceful. And I’m wondering what makes you angry?
